title: A richness-sensitive Acoustic Biodiversity Index from species-level detections: classifier benchmarking, false-positive control and validation against standard soundscape indices in an African savanna and an urban zoo
abstract: arXiv:2610.42042v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Acoustic indices are widely used as rapid proxies for biodiversity, but they summarise the distribution of sound energy rather than the species producing it and often track richness poorly. We revise and test an Acoustic Biodiversity Index (ABI) built from species-level detections. Its primary form, ABI_E, is Shannon diversity of detections normalised by the regional species pool expected at the site and season (H / ln S_ref); temporal stability T is reported as a separate component. We first benchmarked four classifiers on a strongly labelled tropical dataset (1,216 calls, 24 classes) with recording-grouped cross-validation. BirdNET embeddings + logistic regression performed best (macro-F1 0.750 +/- 0.029), and random frame-level splits inflated accuracy from 0.41 to 0.70. We then applied BirdNET v2.4 with a location and season filter to recordings from a riverine savanna in the Zambezi Valley, Zimbabwe, and from three habitats at Emira

translated_title: 一种基于物种级检测的丰富度敏感声学生物多样性指数：分类器基准测试、假阳性控制以及在非洲稀树草原和城市动物园中与标准声景指数的对比验证
translated_abstract: 声学指数被广泛用作生物多样性的快速替代指标，但它们总结的是声能的分布而非产生声音的物种，且往往难以很好地反映物种丰富度。我们修订并测试了一种由物种级检测构建的声学生物多样性指数（ABI）。其主要形式 ABI_E 是检测的香农多样性，并按该地点和季节所预期的区域物种库进行归一化（H / ln S_ref）；时间稳定性 T 作为单独的组成部分报告。我们首先在一个强标注的热带数据集（1,216条叫声，24个类别）上，采用按录音分组的交叉验证方法对四个分类器进行了基准测试。结果显示，BirdNET嵌入加逻辑回归表现最佳（宏F1为0.750 ± 0.029），而随机的帧级数据划分会将准确率从0.41虚增至0.70。随后，我们将带有位置和季节过滤器的BirdNET v2.4应用于来自津巴布韦赞比西河谷河岸稀树草原以及Emira（城市动物园）三个栖息地的录音（摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 该研究提出并验证了一种由物种级检测构建、经区域物种库归一化的丰富度敏感声学生物多样性指数（ABI），通过分类器基准测试与假阳性控制，证明其比传统声景指数能更可靠地反映物种丰富度。
en_tdlr: This study proposes and validates a richness-sensitive Acoustic Biodiversity Index (ABI) built from species-level detections and normalized by the regional species pool, demonstrating through classifier benchmarking and false-positive control that it reflects species richness more reliably than standard soundscape indices.
